items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Mack, and he said Hawk, why don't you call it "Tuxedo Junction" cause I was asking for suggestions as to what we should call it.

ctx.x: * RCA Victor did not exist then; it was merely Victor Records.

Mack, and he said Hawk, why don't you call it "Tuxedo Junction" cause I was asking for suggestions as to what we should call it. Then, he said you used to play out there all the time in the summer. He said call it "Tuxedo Junction". So, I said that's it.

And so, that tune from that beat kind of stuck with me, and that tempo. And, I liked that. So, we started talking other arrangements over and tried to stay somewhere near that. And, that's how we actually, it kind of got to me then. And, I liked that tempo, although we did other things. But, that tempo and that sound.
